concerns.text: Task T014 is marked unchecked (empty) despite FR-003 and FR-006 mandating the exclusion of methodological shifts and >20% sample size changes. Without this task, the pipeline processes invalid pairs, violating the spec's core filtering requirements.

FR-002 explicitly requires applying censored data methods (Tobit regression) for paired effect-size analysis when inequalities exist. Task T023b (implementing the Tobit model) is unchecked, leaving the censored data requirement unimplemented and risking a violation of the spec's statistical rigor.

FR-004 mandates comparing p-curve *results* (power/p-hacking prevalence) rather than raw density ratios. Tasks T022b and T022c, which implement this specific comparison logic, are unchecked, creating a high risk that the analysis will default to raw ratios and violate the spec.

SC-002 requires the observed density ratio to fall outside a 95% confidence interval of a null distribution. Tasks T026a (generate null distribution) and T026 (validate against null) are unchecked, meaning the primary success criterion for distributional shift has no active implementation path.

SC-004 requires verifying bias direction consistency across thresholds {0.01, 0.05, 0.1}. Tasks T028 (sweep thresholds) and T031 (verify consistency) are unchecked, leaving the robustness requirement unmeasured and the spec's sensitivity analysis incomplete.

FR-002 requires excluding inequality p-values from p-curve analysis. While T021a adds a filter, the upstream task T016 (interval-censoring logic to tag data) is unchecked. This creates a dependency gap where the filter may run on data that hasn't been properly tagged as censored, violating the data integrity requirement.

User Story 2 acceptance scenario 3 explicitly requires outputting results stratified by field for domain-specific bias detection. Task T024 (stratification logic) is unchecked, meaning the analysis will output aggregate results only, failing the spec's acceptance criteria.
